dataset_story: A large-scale suite of synthetic datasets modeling bank account opening fraud. It is the first public dataset to incorporate explicit fairness and bias considerations.
aura_purpose: Evaluates robustness and fairness of account opening risk models.

citation.text: Jesus, S. et al. (2022). Turning the Tables: Biased, Imbalanced, Dynamic Tabular Datasets for ML Evaluation. NeurIPS.
